suppressions.candidate: Concurrent final-document reissues could duplicate a version
suppressions.note: The metadata transaction locks the application row before reading the latest version, and the migration enforces unique (application_id, kind, version). This meets TechSpec §Final Documents issuance rules.

suppressions.candidate: Secretariat application query could expose restricted family data
suppressions.note: The secretaria branch uses a server-side allowlist for only the specified application, parent-contact, decision-date, and student identity fields; it does not fetch the complete application row.

suppressions.candidate: Secretariat could download an unissued, historical, or ineligible final document
suppressions.note: Downloads accept a persisted issued-document ID, resolve storage_path server-side, and the secretaria path compares that ID with the current status-eligible document set. History remains guarded by requireAdmin.

suppressions.candidate: Direct scholarship submission could bypass required document categories
suppressions.note: The unconditional Zod requirements execute before school-year lookup and validateDocumentCategories separately verifies every fixed and indexed student category below a pending UUID path.

suppressions.candidate: Donor-first public ordering or legacy route transition could violate the public contract
suppressions.note: Navigation, hero, content bands, and quick access put the canonical benefactor route before scholarship; legacy route pages are direct permanent redirects and the canonical scholarship page retains force-dynamic.

suppressions.candidate: The executable seal might differ from the approved Open Design master or lack semantic modes
suppressions.note: public/seal-arca.svg byte-matches docs/design/opendesign/assets/seal-arca-master.svg; SealLogo forwards caller size/class and uses empty alt plus aria-hidden only for decorative use.
